neighbours.label: the contracted auxiliary clitic 've or 'll after a pronoun (you've, we'll), weaker on possessive 's and 're; not the full forms have/will
fire: By the time the kettle boils, I'll have set the table.
If they've already left, we can lock the gate.
Tell her we'll meet at the fountain at six.
You've grown at least an inch since the summer.
When the rain stops, they'll start mowing the field.
I've never seen the river this high in March.
He'll be surprised to find the shop closed.
After the concert, we've a long drive home.
quiet: By the time the kettle boils, I will have set the table.
If they have already left, we can lock the gate.
Tell her we shall meet at the fountain at six.
You have grown at least an inch since the summer.
When the rain stops, they will start mowing the field.
I have never seen the river this high in March.
He won't be surprised to find the shop closed.
After the concert, we don't have a long drive home.

predictions: fire 6-8 of 8 at 0.15-0.4 (small max, broad flag 2.6%); full forms and n't under 0.06; the median may fall below 0.3 even if AUROC is high
notes: Probe: you've 0.395, we've 0.232, you'll 0.234, she'll 0.160, God's 0.202, you're 0.151, don't 0.055; full forms 'you have' 0.017, 'you will' 0.031. Layer-3 unit with max 1.32 and a gate-closed regime; the clitic token is the trigger, with 're close behind so quiet items avoid it.
